title: The anti-rug gas-multiplier wiring in executeFullSell is checked only by source-text regexes, not by observing the fee a sell submits, so the anti-rug exit can lose its elevated gas with the test green

evidence.note: Tests 1, 2, 3 and 3b regex-match exitEngine.ts text (within-80-character windows); no fee is observed
Test 7: source text check on executePartialSell
the 3b regex is satisfied by this seam definition alone
the call site that must pass gasMultiplier; not covered by any regex

sibling_sites_checked: mevStrategies/gasMultiplier.test.ts proves the strategies apply a multiplier they are given (real); no test proves executeFullSell hands the anti-rug multiplier to the strategy. Other source-grep tests in the slice (twoStageSigint Test 4b, inclusionReconciliation :920 and :967, api/antiRug, codeQuality) are labelled per file.
severity_rationale: S2: on the most time-critical exit (an active rug), losing the elevated bid delays inclusion while liquidity drains (an S1 class); the tests that claim the wiring do not observe it.
recommendation: Phase 28: drive executeFullSell with reason anti-rug through a real strategy (relay mocked at the wire) and assert the submitted fee is the elevated one; keep source checks only as a supplement.
affected_cases: Test 1: the reason parameter type includes 'anti-rug'
Test 2: when reason='anti-rug', gasMultiplier is derived from ctx.chain.antiRug.gasMultiplier
Test 3: when reason !== 'anti-rug', gasMultiplier is undefined (raw feeData; prior behavior preserved)
Test 3b: gasMultiplier is threaded into the private escalation (Gap-1 closure + Finding A)
Test 7: executePartialSell does NOT call unsubscribeAntiRug
escaped_regression: Pass undefined instead of gasMultiplier to submitPrivateSell at src/exitEngine.ts:909: Test 3b still matches the seam definition at :788 and Test 2 still finds the conditional, so every case stays green while the anti-rug private sell bids the normal fee.
